translation:
Recruitment of Non-Tenure-Track Faculty for Appointment on March 1, 2027

This is the recruitment announcement for non-tenure-track faculty, with appointment effective March 1, 2027.

- Application period: Tuesday, November 17, 2026, 10:00 to Tuesday, November 24, 2026, 15:00
- How to apply: Apply through the Seoul National University recruitment website (https://facultyrecruitment.snu.ac.kr)
- Details: Refer to the attached announcement

Attachment (1 file):
Seoul National University College of Engineering, Announcement of New Recruitment of Non-Tenure-Track Faculty for Appointment on March 1, 2027 (Department of Nuclear Engineering)_department homepage.pdf (246 KB)

[Note: The content of the attached PDF was not read for this translation.]
